entry_points.summary: Thin bash wrapper; single entrypoint for all consultant/reviewer dispatch sites
Loads configs, merges, validates, checks PATH, enforces invariant, prints JSON descriptor
Locates and loads global + repo JSON; validates schema version; runs v1->v2 upgrade
In-memory v1->v2 upgrade: adds model_arg_template/model_env_var/default_model nulls; emits provider_schema_v1_upgraded (memoized per process+path)
Per-key merge of global + repo configs across providers/roles/aliases with shadow detection
Role->provider->command lookup with PATH presence check; exits 1 if unresolvable
Invariant: consultant_primary != consultant_secondary; exits 1 on collision
Builds full argv from descriptor + effective_model; renders {model} in model_arg_template; raises ValueError if no model
Probes PATH for known CLIs; returns proposed providers.json dict (never writes)
Resolves all three roles, prints summary line, emits provider_resolved events
Python API wrapper around resolve-provider.py for runtime dispatch layer
JSON Schema Draft 7 for .z-harness/providers.json; accepts version 1+2; permits kind=cli|sdk; allow_cross_vendor_env field

invariants: consultant_primary and consultant_secondary must resolve to distinct provider names — resolver exits 1 if they collide.
Repo-local config overrides user-global config per-key across providers, roles, and aliases sections. Shadowing emits provider_shadowed event and stderr warning, de-duped per parent process.
Schema version field must be 1 or 2; any other value causes exit 2. Version 1 is upgraded in-memory to v2 automatically.
Every provider entry in the merged config is validated on every resolver call, not just the entry being resolved.
discover-providers.py never writes files — all writes go through /z-providers-discover with explicit user confirmation.
compose_argv raises ValueError (not sys.exit) when no model can be resolved from effective_model or provider default_model.
gotchas: Schema at runtime/contract/provider.schema.json permits kind='sdk' and optional auth_env/session_resumable/allow_cross_vendor_env, but resolve-provider.py validates only kind='cli' — SDK entries pass schema but cause exit 2 if resolved.
Z_HARNESS_REPO_PROVIDERS env var overrides repo config path entirely, bypassing git-based discovery.
Shadow de-dup stamp file is keyed on PPID, not PID — warning fires once per parent process tree, not once per subshell.
role with no bound provider causes immediate halt with actionable error pointing to /z-providers-discover.
CLI not on PATH causes exit 1 even if the config entry is otherwise valid.
_upgrade_v1_to_v2 is memoized per (process, file path) via module-level _v1_upgrade_emitted set — double-emission is prevented when both global and repo configs are v1.
aliases section is merged per-key but is NOT used by resolve() — it is informational for rename tooling only.
